lessons.title: 1. Defining Classes & Constructors
lessons.description: Constructors initialize new objects. Define a `Car` class with `make` and `year` fields and getters.
learning_objectives: Create constructors and private fields with getters in Java

tests.name: test_car
tests.test_code: Car c = new Car("Toyota", 2022); if (!"Toyota".equals(c.getMake()) || c.getYear() != 2022) throw new AssertionError("Expected Toyota 2022");

source.name: Oracle Java Tutorials — Providing Constructors — 'they use the name of the class and have no return type'

lessons.title: 2. Instance Methods & State
lessons.description: Add instance methods that alter or inspect object state. Implement `BankAccount` with `deposit` and `withdraw`.
learning_objectives: Implement state mutation methods with validation

tests.name: test_deposit
tests.test_code: BankAccount acc = new BankAccount(100.0); acc.deposit(50.0); if (Math.abs(acc.getBalance() - 150.0) > 0.001) throw new AssertionError("Expected 150.0");

source.name: Oracle Java Tutorials — Using Objects — invoke methods on object references

lessons.title: 3. Smartphone Battery Model (Concept Challenge)
lessons.description: Model a Smartphone with battery percentage and drain/charge methods.

tests.name: test_smartphone
tests.test_code: Smartphone phone = new Smartphone("Pixel"); phone.useApp(2); if (phone.getBatteryLevel() != 70) throw new AssertionError("Expected 70");

lessons.title: 4. Student Gradebook (Practice)
lessons.description: Student is an encapsulated record: private name and score fields set by the constructor. Implement isPassing() to return true when this.score >= 60. The test creates new Student("Ada", 85) and expects isPassing() == true.
learning_objectives: Pass grade letter based on score field

tests.name: test_passing
tests.test_code: Student s = new Student("Ada", 85); if (!s.isPassing()) throw new AssertionError("Ada passes");

source.name: Oracle Java Tutorials — Controlling Access to Members of a Class (private fields)
source.license: Oracle Free Use Terms and Conditions (documentation)

lessons.title: 5. Unit 6 Checkpoint: Java OOP Mastery
lessons.description: Rectangle keeps private width/height fields initialized by the constructor. Implement getArea() to return this.width * this.height. The test expects new Rectangle(4.0, 5.0).getArea() == 20.0 (within 0.001).

tests.name: test_area
tests.test_code: Rectangle r = new Rectangle(4.0, 5.0); if (Math.abs(r.getArea() - 20.0) > 0.001) throw new AssertionError("Expected 20.0");

source.name: Oracle Java Tutorials — Controlling Access to Members of a Class (private fields)
